mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_role (role_id, tenant_id, name, code, type, status, perm_ids, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{code}, #{type}, #{status}, #{permIds}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT role_id, tenant_id, name, code, type, status, perm_ids, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at
